About the Team

OpenAI's Legal team plays a crucial role in furthering OpenAI's mission by tackling innovative, fundamental legal issues in AI. If you're passionate about doing significant and unique work as a technology lawyer, this team is for you. The team comprises professionals from diverse fields, including technology, AI, privacy, IP, corporate, employment, tax law, regulatory, and litigation.

About the Role

As a member of our Product Counsel team, you will advise on a broad range of issues arising from hardware products and technologies, with a focus on software that power them. You’ll work closely with software engineering, product, design, and business teams from development through launch and ongoing support. This is a unique opportunity to engage directly with the forefront of AI legal issues. This role reports to our DGC of Hardware.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

- Work closely with product and engineering teams, participate in architecture and product reviews, and advise throughout development, launch, and ongoing support.

- Support software and firmware licensing, open-source, compatibility and ongoing device support.

- Provide broad product counseling on consumer experiences, user terms, disclosures, marketing claims, consumer protection and regulatory requirements.

- Advise and coordinate on product, commercial, IP, privacy, security, competition, and regulatory legal issues so product decisions and external commitments are consistent.

- Build practical guidance and review processes, adapt support to changing priorities, and take ownership of emerging issues across teams.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have 8+ years of relevant legal experience, including substantial product counseling for consumer devices, software embedded in hardware, gained in-house, at a technology-focused law firm, or both.

- Can work with engineers on embedded software and firmware, hardware dependencies, and translate that understanding into practical advice.

- Have experience with software licensing and the legal issues that arise when device software, apps, and connected services work together.

- Build trusted cross-functional relationships and explain complex issues clearly, balancing legal risk with product goals and responsible development.

- Take ownership and bring an adaptable, collaborative working style: shift priorities, learn unfamiliar issues, and move between strategic advice and hands-on problem solving while knowing when to involve specialists.

- Have a JD and license or qualification to practice in CA.

At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Job Purpose and Summary:

At CVS Health, we are focused on transforming health care for our customers and making our company a great place to work. We help people navigate the health care system – and their personal health care – by improving access, lowering costs and being a trusted partner for every meaningful moment of health. Within our Retail locations, we bring this promise to life with heart every day and our Pharmacy Technicians (Technicians) play a critical role in supporting our pharmacy teams to consistently deliver on our brand promise.

As a Technician, you will support the pharmacy team in delivering operational and service excellence within your store. Technicians are often the first point of contact to assist our patients and customers to deliver an exceptional experience. Technicians assist the pharmacy team to ensure that pharmacy operations run smoothly, our patients’ prescriptions are filled promptly, safely, and accurately, and we are providing caring service that exceeds patient expectations. Technicians operate as part of the pharmacy team through consistent application of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), best practices, and effective communication. Throughout their shifts and in all customer and colleague interactions, they demonstrate genuine care and contribute to a safe and inclusive culture where all people feel valued and empowered.

Once in role, Technicians are required to complete a rigorous company training program and satisfy all registration, licensing, and certification requirements according to their State’s Board of Pharmacy guidelines. Until the Pharmacy Technician has completed all necessary requirements, duties may be restricted by the Pharmacy Manager.

A Technician is responsible for contributing to safe and effective operations of the pharmacy, including but not limited to:

• Living our purpose by following all company SOPs at each workstation to help our Pharmacists manage and improve patient health
• Following pharmacy workflow procedures at each pharmacy workstation (i.e., production, pick-up, drive-thru, and drop-off) for safe and accurate prescription fulfillment
• Contributing to positive patient experiences by showing empathy and genuine care: creating heartfelt and personalized moments while serving patients at pick-up, drive-thru, and over the phone; keeping patients healthy by offering immunizations and other services at the register and over the phone; and demonstrating compassionate care by solving or escalating patient problems
• Completing basic inventory activities, as permitted by law, and as directed by the pharmacy leadership team, such as accurately putting away medication deliveries and completing cycle counts, returns-to-stocks, waiting bin inventories, etc.
• Contributing to a high-performing team, embracing a growth mindset, and being receptive to feedback; actively seeking opportunities to expand clinical and technical knowledge needed to better assist patients
• Remaining flexible for both scheduling and business needs, while contributing to a safe, inclusive, and engaging team dynamic; voluntarily traveling to stores in the market to work shifts as needed by the business

Complying with CVS policies and procedures to ensure patient safety, compliance with controlled substance dispensing and recordkeeping, and to protect patient privacy and security
• Delivering additional patient health care services (e.g., immunizations, point-of-care testing, and voluntarily staffing offsite clinics), where allowable by law and supported by required training and certification

Where permissible, the Pharmacy Technician may also support immunizations, which includes the following responsibilities:

• Completing additional licensure and training requirements, in compliance with state Board of Pharmacy regulations, to obtain Technician Immunizer status to support preparing and administering vaccines
• Educating patients about the importance of vaccines and referring patients to the Pharmacist-on-duty for vaccination questions
• Monitoring for, and responding to, adverse reactions; reporting adverse reaction events per public health requirements

You will redesign processes, build the workflows that execute them across Rippling, Slack, Notion and the rest of our stack, and own offboarding and our employee support model outright. You cannot automate a process well without running one, so you will do both. You will own the outcome, not just the design. Strategic Sourcing & Procurement helps OpenAI secure the products, services, and partnerships that support our research, build our products, and grow our business. We work with teams across the company to make sound commercial decisions and move important work forward.

As OpenAI grows, we are rethinking how sourcing works: bringing expertise into decisions earlier, simplifying contracting, and using AI to give Procurement more time for judgment and strategic work. ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a senior leader to head Sourcing Enablement & Delivery, leading sourcing operational delivery, contracting enablement, and AI transformation—and building Procurement’s contribution to OpenAI’s commercial growth. You will build the teams, systems, service model, and cross-functional partnerships that enable sourcing and contracting at scale, helping teams move quickly without losing commercial discipline or accountability.

You will partner with GTM, Sales, and Partnerships to develop Procurement’s contribution to OpenAI adoption and commercial growth. Bring procurement-industry knowledge, buyer insights, and lessons from internal AI use into customer engagement, product feedback, and opportunities across the procurement ecosystem.

Reporting to the Head of Strategic Sourcing, you will manage the Sourcing Delivery and Contract Management leaders and shape this new function’s priorities, team, and measures of success.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

PRIORITIES AND WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- A focused roadmap: clear choices about what to build first, what to defer, and how progress will be measured.

- Stronger delivery: capable leaders and teams, faster execution, less rework, and fewer unresolved ownership gaps.

- AI adoption: sustained use of AI-enabled capabilities, with measurable gains in quality, capacity, and user experience.

- Commercial results: increased OpenAI adoption across the procurement industry and a measurable contribution to commercial growth, consistent with independent supplier selection and purchasing decisions.

Own use-case priorities, adoption, and business outcomes for sourcing and contracting experiences that begin in ChatGPT and connect to trusted enterprise systems. - Bring procurement-buyer expertise into GTM. Own this team’s buyer insights and use cases. Work with Marketing, Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Partnerships to shape demonstrations, industry content, and customer conversations, using examples approved for external use.

Contribute industry expertise and evidence from internal use; GTM and Partnerships own commercialization.

- Partner with Legal and Compliance to embed business-integrity and confidentiality safeguards; implement required disclosures, recusals, and independent-decision making arrangements.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

会社概要

ロケットナウ（Rocket Now）について

ロケットナウは、送料とサービス料が無料のフードデリバリーサービスです。和食、洋食、ヘルシー志向の料理など多彩なジャンルの料理から、デザートやドリンクまで迅速かつお得にお楽しみいただけます。サービスは、北海道、東北（仙台）、関東（東京・神奈川・埼玉・千葉）、中部（愛知・静岡）、関西（大阪・京都・兵庫）、広島、九州（福岡）を中心に展開中です。 ロケットナウアプリは、グローバルマーケットインテリジェンス企業の「センサータワー（Sensor Tower）」が主催する「Sensor Tower APAC Awards 2025」にて、「2025年に世界でローンチされた飲食店注文・フードデリバリーアプリ部門」で「世界最多ダウンロード数を記録」したアプリに認定されました。また、『Best App Award 2025』において、カテゴリ別部門ショッピングカテゴリ優秀賞を受賞。iOS／Androidの両アプリストアのダウンロード数は、フードデリバリーアプリ部門9カ月連続1位を獲得しました1。アプリはサービス開始2から15カ月で500万ダウンロードを突破するなど成長を続けています。 ＊1 2025年7〜2026年3月 iOS、Android 統合ベース ＊2 2025年3月30日 サービスリリース時点 （出所：Global Market Intelligence: Sensor Tower）

CP One Japanについて

CP One Japan合同会社は、NYSE（ニューヨーク証券取引所）に上場しているFortune 150のテクノロジー企業Coupang, Inc.（NYSE: CPNG）の日本法人です。CP One Japanは、日本国内で「ロケットナウ（Rocket Now）」ブランドのフードデリバリーサービスを運営しており、Coupangの技術力と革新的な物流ソリューションを生かして、迅速で信頼性の高い顧客志向のフードデリバリーサービスを日本の消費者に提供することに尽力しています。

職務概要

Process Innovationチームは、Rocket Now Merchantのオンボーディングにおいて、サービス開始から日々の運営までの間に発生するあらゆる社内外のプロセスを改善する責任を担っています。そのため、チームメンバーは店舗訪問や外部パートナーとの会議、社内のさまざまな部門との連携を行うことがあります。プロセス設計、分析、オペレーションに関する経験が必須であり、さまざまなITテクノロジーに関する知識があれば尚可です。

• End-to-End Process Optimization: 加盟店のライフサイクル全体（オンボーディング、メニュー／カタログ管理、店舗公開、日常オペレーション、精算業務など）にわたる社内外のワークフローを分析し、再設計・標準化・拡張を推進する。
• Operational Workflow Improvement: Slack Workflows、Google Sheets、Salesforce、Webhookなどのツールを活用し、自動化されたコミュニケーションおよび業務ワークフローを設計・導入することで、手動オペレーションを削減し、加盟店のセットアップを迅速化するとともに、課題のエスカレーションプロセスを効率化する。
• Onsite Diagnostics & Field Immersion: 店舗訪問や加盟店オペレーション監査を実施し、業務上のボトルネックを特定する。店舗レベルの業務フローを評価し、現場で発生している課題を拡張可能なオペレーションソリューションへと落とし込む。
• Cross-Functional Process Alignment: 各プロセスオーナーと技術部門の橋渡し役として機能し、部門間の業務引き継ぎを円滑化するとともに、オペレーション上の課題や重複業務を解消する。
• Data-Driven Performance Tracking & SOPs: オンボーディング処理件数、カタログ対応時間、精算精度、全体リードタイムなどを可視化するための自動データパイプラインやダッシュボードを構築する。また、標準業務手順書（SOP）やチェンジマネジメントガイドラインを策定・運用する。

必須スキル・経験（Basic Qualifications）

• EC、デリバリープラットフォーム、小売、またはO2O業界において、Process Design、Operations Excellence、Business Operations、またはManagement Consultingの経験を5年以上有すること。
• SQL、Excel（高度な関数、ピボットテーブル、VBA／マクロ）、Google Sheets（Google Apps Script）を活用した高度なデータ処理およびデータモデリングスキルを有すること。
• Slack（Slack Workflows、各種インテグレーション）およびSalesforceを活用した業務プロセス管理やデータトラッキングの実務経験を有すること。
• Slack WorkflowsとGoogle Sheets／Salesforceを連携させるなど、ノーコード／ローコードによる業務自動化や通知フローの構築経験を有すること。
• データ活用によって業務上のボトルネックを特定し、明確なKPIを伴う部門横断的な業務改善プロジェクトを推進した実績を有すること。
• 現場訪問や業務フローの可視化、フロントライン担当者へのヒアリングなどを積極的に実施できる実践的なマインドセットを有すること。
• ビジネスレベルの英語力。

歓迎スキル・経験（Preferred Qualifications）

• PythonまたはRを活用した高度なデータ分析や業務自動化スクリプト開発の実務経験。
• RPA（Robotic Process Automation）やローコード統合プラットフォームの構築・運用経験。
• Salesforceの高度な管理・カスタマイズ経験（Flow Builder、カスタムオブジェクト、インテグレーショントリガーなど）。
• BIツールを活用したオペレーション指標ダッシュボードの構築経験。
• EC／デリバリープラットフォーム業界のオペレーションに関する深い理解を有し、特に加盟店オンボーディング、カタログ管理、または精算プロセスに関する経験を有すること。
• Lean、Six Sigma、またはAgileプロジェクトマネジメント手法に関する資格または実務経験。
• 日本語が流暢であること。

採用プロセス

書類選考 → 電話／Zoom面接 → オンサイト（またはオンライン）面接 → 内定
※職種や状況により、プロセスが変更される場合があります。
※面接日程や結果は、応募時にご提出いただいたメールアドレス宛にご連絡いたします。

勤務条件

• 雇用形態：詳細は面談時にご説明いたします。
• 試用期間：あり（期間・条件は別途通知）
• 契約期間：該当する場合は、契約期間を別途ご案内いたします。
• その他の詳細：ご応募後、別途ご案内いたします。

留意事項

• 本求人は、募集枠が充足された場合、掲載終了日より前に募集を終了する可能性があります。
• 応募プロセスにおいて虚偽の情報が提出された場合、Coupangは採用内定を取り消す権利を有します。
• 法令に基づき、雇用保護の対象となる方（例：退役軍人給付受給者、障がい者等）には、優先的な選考を行う場合があります。
• 入社時または入社後の業務内容・職位は、候補者の経験や事業上の必要性に応じて変更となる可能性があります。変更後の職務内容・職位については、特別な制限を設けないものとし、入社前に適切なタイミングでご案内いたします。
• 応募後の詳細は、メールまたは面接時に別途ご案内いたします。

プライバシー通知

ご応募に際してご提供いただく個人情報は、以下のプライバシーポリシーに基づき、Coupangが収集・管理いたします：https://www.coupang.jobs/jp/privacy-policy/

機会均等

Coupangは、多様で包括的な職場を目指しています。Coupangは機会均等雇用者です。

About Rocket Now

Rocket Now is a food delivery service with no delivery or service fees. Consumers can enjoy a wide variety of cuisines, from Japanese and Western food to healthy options, as well as desserts and drinks, quickly and affordably. The service is currently available mainly in Hokkaido, Tohoku (Sendai), Kanto (Tokyo, Kanagawa, Saitama, Chiba), Chubu (Aichi,Shizuoka), Kansai (Osaka, Kyoto, Hyogo), Hiroshima, and Kyushu (Fukuoka). Rocket Now won the Excellence Award in the Shopping Category at the Best App Awards 2025. Furthermore, it has achieved the No. 1 ranking in the Food Delivery App category for nine consecutive months on both the iOS and Android app stores (*1), and the app continues to grow, surpassing 5 million downloads in just 15 months since its launch (*2). *1 Based on integrated iOS and Android data from July 2025 to March 2026. *2 As of January 14, 2025, service release date (Source: Global Market Intelligence: Sensor Tower)

About CP One Japan

CP One Japan LLC is the Japanese subsidiary of Coupang, Inc. (NYSE: CPNG), a US-based company listed on the NYSE (New York Stock Exchange) and one of the Fortune 150 companies, known as a technology company. CP One Japan operates the "Rocket Now" brand food delivery service in Japan, leveraging Coupang's technological capabilities and innovative logistics solutions to provide fast, reliable, and customer-oriented food delivery services to Japanese consumers.

The IT Product Manager is responsible to lead and coordinate cross-functional delivery teams and technology partners to design, build (develop/configure/test) and deliver system solution within their business unit, setting the vision for the product, and developing the IT roadmap for achieving it.
